hero.title: Silo — S3 (Premiere, Ep 1 streaming)
hero.format: 10-ep season, weekly Fridays through 9/4; Ep 2 'It's All Good' drops 7/10
hero.about: Juliette returns from her forced exile with her memory wiped, now the silo's mayor. A prequel timeline set centuries earlier explores how the world ended. S4 is already locked as the final season.
hero.why: You rated Silo S1–S2 at 4.5⭐ and pinned S3 to your watchlist — Ep 1 has been streaming since 3am ET Friday. S3 opened at 100% on Rotten Tomatoes ('a masterful dystopian tale with expertly driven character arcs') and hit #1 on Apple TV's global chart in 97 countries within 24 hours. Sci-fi + world-building + book adaptation hits every taste-profile box. Ep 2 lands Friday 7/10 — a perfect Sat-night start-your-Silo-weekend hero.
hero.priority_reason: Watchlist title still just-became-streamable (Ep 1 dropped 2026-07-03) — reinforced by 100% RT + #1 global streaming chart. Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle would be a Tier-1 Loved-list continuation, but its confirmed 7/28 date is still 24 days out — surfaced prominently in upcoming_alerts instead.
